metadata.title: Veteran Bank Revamps AMD Stock Price Target for 2027

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) rose in focus after UBS lifted its price target to $670 from $455 while maintaining a Buy rating, citing improving server CPU demand trends, according to a UBS research note.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) has also benefited from strong momentum over the past year, with shares climbing roughly 275% to about $519.85, while valuation concerns persist as the stock trades above estimated fair value.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) is seeing support from expectations tied to broader adoption of standalone server CPUs, particularly as artificial intelligence workloads expand across global data centers and cloud infrastructure.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) estimates were lifted, with UBS raising CPU server revenue projections for 2026, 2027 and 2028 to $16 billion, $23 billion and $29 billion, up from prior levels, while 2030 forecasts increased to $50 billion from $41 billion, based on an unchanged 35x multiple.
Analysts suggest that despite strong profitability and cash generation, Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) may remain sensitive to valuation compression and execution risks if growth in key server markets slows or competition intensifies.
